subject: Post-demo MAP draft + reforecast request (HealthBridge)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthbridge.com>, Denis Roy <denis.roy@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo MAP draft + next steps (HealthBridge)

Hi Samantha / Denis —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the demo time. Per our call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a target close date. Key points from the call:

- Objective: Production inference for user-facing features (pilot -> full rollout)
- Initial target close: Oct 22, 2026 (for procurement + pilot kickoff)
- Proposed milestones in attached MAP v1:
  1) Procurement & Contract (HealthBridge legal + Redwood sales) — target: 10/22/2026
  2) Pilot scoping & SOW (HealthBridge Eng + Redwood SE) — target: 11/05/2026
  3) Pilot execution (HealthBridge Pilot Team + Redwood Ops) — target: 12/03/2026
  4) Production rollout (Customer Success + Platform) — target: 01/15/2027

Responsibilities are called out in the MAP (attached). Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, procurement timeline, and pilot resource allocation.

Next steps:
- Samantha / Denis: review MAP and flag any changes to milestones or owners by end of next week (9/27)
- Redwood (me + Dev): prepare SOC2 summary and technical checklist
- Marissa: propose CSM onboarding dates once pilot milestone confirmed

Attachment: HealthBridge-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthbridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Denis Roy <denis.roy@healthbridge.com>, procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: 2026-09-28T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP draft + next steps (HealthBridge)

Connor —

Thanks for the recap and MAP draft. Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed our internal approval window out (we have a Q4 freeze on large vendor commits until procurement finalizes the vendor list). That means our original target of 10/22 is no longer realistic. At minimum we need to reforecast close to mid-November.

Also, leadership asked us to invert the order: they want a short pilot (4–6 weeks) completed before final contract execution for full rollout — effectively procurement wants to see pilot results before committing to an enterprise contract.

Can you update the MAP with:
- New target close date: 2026-11-15 (for pilot kickoff approval + POC SOW start)
- Reprioritize milestones so pilot is first and contract signing is contingent on pilot results
- Include SOC2 summary and a high-level implementation checklist for the pilot

I've attached our procurement timeline for visibility. We'll also loop in legal if the SOW needs redlines.

Samantha Lee
Head of Product Operations | HealthBridge
samantha.lee@healthbridge.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Attachment: HealthBridge-procurement-timeline.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthbridge.com>, Denis Roy <denis.roy@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP draft + next steps (HealthBridge)

Thanks Samantha — totally understood and thanks for the procurement timeline. I've updated the MAP to reflect the reforecast and the reprioritized milestones. High level changes in MAP v2 (attached):

- Target dates updated: pilot-approval & SOW start moved to 2026-11-15; pilot execution window 11/22–12/20/2026; contract decision moved to 01/15/2027
- Milestone order flipped: Pilot scoping & SOW -> Pilot execution -> Contract review & signing
- Owners clarified:
  - Procurement & Contract: HealthBridge (Samantha + Procurement) / Redwood (Connor) — responsible for approvals and contract negotiation
  - Pilot scoping: HealthBridge Eng (Denis) / Redwood SE (Dev) — responsible for success criteria and test plan
  - Pilot execution: HealthBridge Pilot Team / Redwood Ops — responsible for monitoring and acceptance criteria
- Dependencies explicitly called out: SOC2 evidence (we've attached a short SOC2-summary.pdf), access to a staging dataset (HealthBridge), and a signed non-prod usage addendum
- Risks: procurement freeze may push contract commitment to Q1; scope creep in pilot could delay production rollout

Action items for you: please confirm the updated target of 11/15 and that owners look accurate. Once you confirm, we'll:
1) Share final MAP v2 with the legal and procurement thread
2) Have Dev prepare a pilot checklist and staging access plan
3) Marissa to prepare CSM onboarding dates tentatively for mid-Dec

Attachments: HealthBridge-MAP-v2.xlsx; SOC2-summary.pdf

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Subject: Internal: HealthBridge MAP reforecast implications

Connor / Dev —

Saw the updated MAP v2 — looks good. Two quick internal notes:

1) Resource planning: with pilot now 11/22–12/20, we should reserve a SE slot (Dev) + 0.5 FTE from Ops for monitoring during the pilot window. Please confirm availability so I can block Calendars and update SOW estimates.
2) Contract timing: procurement pushing to Jan for signing means we should avoid heavy custom work until contract exec. I'll draft an interim SOW addendum for pilot-only scope to keep legal simple.

I'll join the next call with HealthBridge if you want me on procurement/legal threads.

Thanks —
